Build Power BI dashboards and DAX models for our motor and health insurance business, including claims and policy analytics. You will own metrics, build dashboards and run deep dives with product and business teams.

Requirements
• 2-4 years of experience in analytics
• Strong SQL and Python (Pandas)
• Power BI or Tableau dashboards
• A/B testing and statistics
• Stakeholder management and data storytelling

Nice to have
• BigQuery or Snowflake
• dbt
